policy: Proposed 2027 subscription prices. EUR is the standard display; normal EUR list prices per user/month for 1–6 apps are €27, €51, €72, €91, €107, €134; early adopter EUR prices are €21, €41, €58, €73, €86, €107. Target early adopter savings are ~20% in whole-unit EUR/USD prices (exact percentages are computed by currency); the DKK early-adopter prices remain exactly 20% below DKK normal prices. Planned DKK normal prices remain 200, 380, 540, 680, 800, and 1000. The early adopter period is January–March 2027 for eligible first-year subscriptions. Organisation discount eligibility remains separate and does not stack with early adopter offers. Checkout and billing are not enabled.

referenceConversion.note: ECB reference rates from 29 October 2026 explain the EUR nearest-DKK list levels; the EUR and USD figures are fixed whole-unit planned prices for clear display, not live FX rates. DKK remains its own planned price list. Early adopter savings in EUR/USD are approximately 20% and vary slightly with rounding.
